title: Spanish classes in Atlanta for adults
metaDescription: Spanish lessons in Atlanta for adults, one to one or in small groups, in person or online. Conversation first, built around why you want to learn.
intro: Spanish lessons for adults in Atlanta, one to one or in a small group, in person or online. Conversation from the first lesson, built around why you want to learn: work, travel, family, or the people around you.

sections.heading: Who these lessons are for
sections.body:
People who need Spanish at work: nurses, managers, builders, anyone with Spanish speaking colleagues or customers. People traveling to Mexico, Spain or South America. People with a Spanish speaking partner or family. And people who have tried apps and want a real person to practice with.

Complete beginners are welcome, and so are people who learned some Spanish at school and want it back.

sections.heading: What a lesson looks like
sections.body:
You speak from the first lesson, with the situations you actually face: a conversation at work, a trip, a family dinner. Grammar comes in when you need it. Between lessons you get short, practical things to do.

[EXAMPLE] In person we meet at your home or at a place in Atlanta that works for both of us. Online, the lesson is the same, on video.

faq.a: [EXAMPLE] Everyday Spanish that works across Latin America and Spain. If you need one country in particular, say so and we focus on it.

faq.q: Can you do lessons for two colleagues or a couple?
faq.a: [EXAMPLE] Yes. A small group of two to four people works well and costs less per person.

faq.q: How fast can I learn enough for work?
faq.a: We start with the phrases you need most, so the first lessons are useful at work right away. How fast it goes depends on how much you practice in between.
